context.body: Unity, distinction, works, contested divine identity, and an appeal to Psalm language meet.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Jesus describes shared keeping of the sheep, says he and the Father are one, and defends his claim through works and Scripture.
observations.label: Jesus says he and the Father are one: action

observations.body: Opponents seek a direct answer, attempt stoning for blasphemy, and try to arrest him.
observations.label: Jesus says he and the Father are one: response

observations.body: my Father · are one · make yourself God · Father is in me
observations.label: Words in John 10:22–39

payload.posture: Read John 10:22–39 as jesus and god evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: Jesus’ scriptural defense does not erase the stronger claim that his works disclose mutual indwelling.
payload.title: Jesus says he and the Father are one
